name: Osa-AK against a range-gate pull-off (EM radars; the NPC commander runs the crew)
description: A fictional practice shoot against deception jamming (roadmap 9.4). A strike aircraft with a range-gate pull-off repeater comes in from the north. Once the tracking radar has it, the repeater takes the range gate and walks it off: the operator sees the mark split from the jamming pulse and reports it, the commander orders the counter-jamming on (УВ. ПОМЕХА, СДЦ), the lock is taken again and holds, and the crew fires. When the fight is over the commander has the protection switched off again (voenizdat_osa_1991 p259). Take any seat.
notes: Fictional. Flat plain. The aircraft's numbers and the repeater (generic_rgpo_ku in data/em/generic.json) are PLACEHOLDERS. The drills are counter_pull_off and pull_off_protection_off (data/procedures/osa_ak.json).

jammers.notes: A repeater that answers the tracking radar's pulses and walks the range gate out (delayed pull-off).
